civilopediaText.text: The hearth is the foundation of Aurelia. To nurture a family is to strengthen the future of the Order.

name: The Call of Aurelia
uniques: [+25]% Production when constructing [Military] units [in all cities] <when at war>

civilopediaText.text: When Aurelia is threatened, its people answer. Every citizen has a place in the defense of the home they have chosen.
